div.div:
Each socket adapter wraps an upstream core (e.g. ibex_top, cv32e40p_core, serv_top, picorv32, wallypipelinedcore) and presents a uniform OBI-like instr/data interface plus alert/sleep signals. SERV, PicoRV32, and CVW have native single-port or AHB-Lite buses; their adapters bridge those into the same OBI-like socket boundary.
The selector picks one adapter at elaboration time via the CoreType parameter; only that branch is generated by the synthesis tool.
CVA6 (CoreType = CORE_CVA6) does NOT enter this region: it is wired directly as a native-AXI initiator in soc_top via corejack_cva6_axi_adapter (see Tab 1). The CVA6 branch here only exists to fatal in sim if the split OBI path is mistakenly selected for CVA6.
